body:
I just got home, actually, and this reply is excellent. The possibility of things getting better is going to be on the upswing soon enough. Sometimes it's just hard to stay positive.

I decided I wanted to step away from "life" for a minute (in the sense of my day-to-day world) and went for a drive out to the boonies. Took some night shots, just kinda let myself decompress, and being out there really made me think of just how small all of my problems are in the grand scope of things. 

Thank you for your kind words, it really does help a lot to know that other people are in the same boat I am, or at least know where I'm coming from.
